sloka: सा तम् हरिवरम् दृष्ट्वा लङ्का रावणपालिता ।स्वयमेवोत्थिता तत्र विकृताननदर्शना ॥५-३-२१॥
transliteration: sā tam harivaram dṛṣṭvā laṅkā rāvaṇapālitā ।svayamevotthitā tatra vikṛtānanadarśanā ॥5-3-21॥

translations.english: Seeing the best of vanaras, the deity of the city of Lanka, ruled by Ravana rose up before him in a distorted form.
